mines.mine_notes: El Limon Guajes open pits (winding down; 1,965 kt ore mined in 2025), ELG Underground (1,005 kt mined), plus stockpiles. FY2025 production/costs not split between ELG and Media Luna; consolidated complex figures: payable production 376,364 oz AuEq (315,678 oz Au, 1,286.4 koz Ag, 34.8 Mlbs Cu); sold 361,518 oz AuEq; total cash costs $1,376/oz AuEq sold; AISC $1,783/oz AuEq sold. Average processed grade 3.04 g/t Au, 18.0 g/t Ag, 0.55% Cu; recoveries Au 91.6%, Ag 69.8%, Cu 85.2%; 3,538 kt processed.
mines.processing: ELG processing plant (flotation to copper concentrate + CIP for gold-silver); Media Luna ore processed at ELG plant

mines.mine_notes: Declared commercial production May 1, 2025; 1,504 kt ore mined post-commercial in 2025. Production not reported separately from ELG (see ELG Mine Complex). Media Luna North targeted for first production late 2026.
mines.processing: Ore processed at ELG processing plant

notes: Morelos Complex (Guerrero, Mexico). FY2025 AIF and FY2025 MD&A used. Total P&P reserves (Dec 31, 2025): 39,653 kt @ 3.80 g/t AuEq = 4,839 koz AuEq ($1,650/oz Au, $21/oz Ag, $3.85/lb Cu). Mine breakdown of reserves: Media Luna UG 22,607 kt @ 4.21 g/t AuEq (3,062 koz), Media Luna North UG 5,546 kt @ 4.03 (719 koz), ELG UG 5,011 kt @ 4.80 (773 koz), ELG OP 614 kt @ 2.62 (52 koz), stockpiles 5,876 kt @ 1.23 (233 koz). Production consolidated at complex level only; per-mine ounce production and unit costs not disclosed. Acquired Prime Mining (Los Reyes project) Oct 2025 and Reyna Silver Aug 2025.
